name: Okhla Industrial Zone
description: Dense concentration of industrial units with metal roofing and minimal vegetation. Surface temperatures significantly elevated. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Anand Vihar Transit Hub
description: High-density transit zone with extensive asphalt surfaces, vehicular heat load, and minimal tree cover. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Chandni Chowk Market Corridor
description: Dense urban market with narrow congested streets, high pedestrian density, and concentrated waste heat from commercial activity. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Narela Industrial Cluster
description: Northern industrial cluster with large rooftop heat emitters and sparse green cover. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Karol Bagh Commercial District
description: Mixed commercial zone with glass facades, vehicle congestion, and limited green space. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Connaught Place Urban Core
description: Central business district with high-reflectance paved surfaces and dense foot traffic. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Rohini Residential Sector 10
description: Suburban residential area with moderate building density and partial green cover. DEMO illustrative risk zone.

name: Dwarka Sector 14
description: Suburban planned sector with wide roads. Pavement heat absorption noted in peak summer. DEMO illustrative risk zone.
